The rating for shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) , which happened to be a Buy, has been adjusted by Jefferies, who now rates the shares as a Hold. This is in addition to a target of $160 for AAPL. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Ratings Coverage
Among 17 analysts covering Apple ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 9 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 8 Hold. Therefore 53% are positive. Apple has $310 highest and $165 lowest target. $223.81’s average target is 55.95% above currents $143.51 stock price. Apple had 37 analyst reports since July 23, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Thursday, September 13 by Bank of America. Morgan Stanley maintained Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) rating on Friday, December 7. Morgan Stanley has “Overweight” rating and $236 target. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Thursday, November 29 by Canaccord Genuity. The company was maintained on Wednesday, August 1 by Canaccord Genuity. Morgan Stanley maintained Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) rating on Thursday, September 13. Morgan Stanley has “Overweight” rating and $247 target. The stock has “Hold” rating by Bank of America on Tuesday, November 27. The firm has “Buy” rating by Citigroup given on Friday, November 2. The rating was maintained by Nomura with “Neutral” on Friday, November 2. The rating was maintained by Canaccord Genuity on Tuesday, September 4 with “Buy”. As per Wednesday, September 5, the company rating was maintained by Morgan Stanley.
The stock decreased 9.12% or $14.41 during the last trading session, reaching $143.51. About 41.45 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 0.17% since January 3, 2018 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 0.17% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on February, 7. They expect $4.74 earnings per share, up 21.85 % or $0.85 from last year’s $3.89 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $22.49B for 7.57 P/E if the $4.74 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.91 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 62.89 % EPS growth.
Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players to consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, and education, enterprise, and government clients worldwide. The company has market cap of $681.01 billion. The firm also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. It has a 12.05 P/E ratio. It offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers.
